subject: world_language
concept: Making simple plans using 'I want to' and 'I am going to' in the target language
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR A2 'express simple plans' can-do descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student states a simple future plan aloud using the target-language structure
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a plan phrase to a picture showing a future action
exercise.abstract: Student writes a sentence about something they want to do or are going to do

misconception_flags: confuses present-tense structure with the future/intention structure

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
